title_sq: Tek Materniteti i Ri, Shitet Ambient Komercial I Pershtatshem Per Klinike Mjekesore
description_sq: Prane Maternitetit Te Ri, Shitet Ambient Komercial. Ambienti ndodhet ne zone shume te kerkuar dhe eshte i pershtatshem per klinike mjekesore. Fasada e jashtme prej xhami dhe vendndodhja ne rrugen kryesore e bene ambientin lehtesisht te aksesueshem dhe mund te shfrytezohet si per biznes privat edhe per t'u lene me qira. Ambienti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: At New Maternity, commercial premises for sale, suitable for a medical clinic
description_en: Near the New Maternity Hospital, Commercial Space for Sale. The environment is located in a highly sought-after area and is suitable for a medical clinic. The external glass facade and the location on the main road make the environment easily accessible and can be used both for private business and for rent. The premises have regular mortgage documentation.
